summary: Tested new site_content editorial endpoints (GET /api/content public, PUT /api/admin/content/{section} admin-only) and catalog non-regression. All 10 pytest tests passed. Defaults restored at end. Product count unchanged (13).

minor.issue: _merge_content treats empty list [] as falsy and returns default. If admin legitimately wants to save an empty villes list or footer.links=[], it will be silently replaced by default values. Consider distinguishing 'not set' (None) from 'explicitly empty'.

action_items: (Optional) Reconsider _merge_content semantics for empty lists/strings so admin can explicitly clear a section.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 975 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold; consider splitting content, catalog, auth, payments into modules.

PUT /api/admin/content/{section} accepts Any body without Pydantic validation per section — acceptable given flexibility requirement, but could add per-section validators to prevent bad shapes (e.g., maison must have blocks[] of 3 objects with n/title/text).
seed_data_creation: None. Modified site_content 'home' doc temporarily, restored to defaults via test_99_restore_defaults. Verified via public GET /api/content post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes for editorial content live in /app/backend/server.py lines 848-895. Collection db.site_content, single doc {key:'home'}. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_site_content.py covers: public GET, auth guard on PUT, hero/villes(array body)/maison/salons/footer updates, unknown section 400, and catalog non-regression (product count + GET by id).
